text: Appeal of Dangerous Dog Order issued, October 5, 2022, Appeal DDRT2023-08.

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Rescinded the determination of a dangerous dog and exempted the Applicant from compliance with the Dangerous Dog Order issued October 5, 2022, and directed that the Tribunal forward the reasons for this decision to Emese Lath and the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards on or before April 7, 2023.
